propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate built and maintained the training and evaluation pipelines for the triage model, including the repair-estimate and photo-metadata feature refresh.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the pipeline configuration document the pipeline work.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate wrote the training-data and known-limitation sections of the model cards for versions 2.1 and 2.2.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the model card document the documentation work.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate owned the triage model end-to-end, including model design and release decisions.
propositions.rationale: The resume assigns release decisions to the lead data scientist and the model risk committee and describes the candidate as one of three engineers; the portfolio slide summarises the team's work.

expectedGap: The materials show pipeline ownership and documentation; they do not show the candidate taking model design or release decisions.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the boundary the resume states: pipelines and model-card sections by the candidate, release decisions by the lead data scientist and the model risk committee; the portfolio slide is not evidence of ownership.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask which design and release decisions the candidate took personally and whether he ever presented to the model risk committee as the accountable owner.
